'''2018 European MPC Results Jonas Jacobsen LS You Can Either Profit By This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jonas Jacobsen]] at [[2018 European Match Play Championship]] (Results).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jonas Jacobsen]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open You Can Either Profit By This Jacob.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-match-play-championships/ PC list]
